note: Clinical vignettes are synthetic author-created illustrations for owner review of wording and missingness behavior. They are NOT empirical probabilities, NOT guideline cutoffs, and NOT an independent clinical oracle. The numerical fixture is an independently hand-worked mathematical check of table ordering and inference plumbing, computed by plain enumeration outside the implementation under test.

numerical_fixture.ordering_contract: child state fastest; last declared parent next; first declared parent slowest

checks.name: root-parent outputs read one row; downstream outputs mix over the indication
checks.work: indication (confirmed, prefers_lai, poor) -> [0.85, 0.15]; safety (absent, supported) -> [0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.70]; delivery (yes, absent) -> [0.05, 0.05, 0.10, 0.80]; discussion mixes over indication: 0.85*[0.80,0.12,0.08]+0.15*[0.08,0.12,0.80]=[0.692,0.120,0.188]; choice mixes over indication: 0.85*(nine 0.09 plus deferred 0.19)+0.15*(nine 0.04 plus deferred 0.64)=nine 0.0825 plus deferred 0.2575

checks.name: transpose detector: swapping first/last parent changes the row
checks.work: indication rows differ by rule leg (criterion met vs not met); an implementation that transposes parent order returns the wrong row. Choice-level check: (indicated, evidence_supported, considering) -> nine 9.0 plus deferred 19.0 versus (not_established, evidence_supported, considering) -> nine 4.0 plus deferred 64.0.
